package.input_schema: Verified C(v,k,t) covering design witness dictionary containing family, params (v, k, t), and blocks.
package.output_schema: Lifted C(v+1,k+1,t) covering design witness dictionary containing family, params, blocks, provenance, and claimBoundary.
package.heldout_expected_contract: Given any valid C(v,k,t) covering design witness from heldout split, compiles a valid C(v+1,k+1,t) covering design witness with identical block count.
package.claim_boundary: Constructively proves that if C(v,k,t) has a covering design of size b, then C(v+1,k+1,t) has a covering design of size at most b, witnessed by appending point v to all blocks.
stop_conditions: Input target is not a dictionary or missing required keys.
Params v, k, t are missing or fail v > k >= t >= 1 constraint.
Blocks list is empty, malformed, or contains elements out of range [0, v-1].
